style_description.description: A brief description of the client's preferred style for the <class> solutions.

budget_range.description: The available budget range for the <class> solutions.

durability_requirement.description: The required durability level for the <class> solutions, such as temporary, medium-term, or long-lasting.

maintenance_level.description: The preferred level of maintenance for the <class> solutions, such as low, medium, or high.
